relic_sets.notes: First-listed relic set (Sunday.ts:443): Sacerdos' Relived Ordeal 4-piece (+18% CRIT DMG to the target of his Skill or Ultimate, 2 stacks).

ornament_set.name: Broken Keel
ornament_set.notes: First-listed ornament (Sunday.ts:447): Broken Keel (+10% Effect RES; at 30% RES or more, allies +10% CRIT DMG). His trace gives 18% RES, the set 10%, and the 2 fixed rolls 7.8%, so 35.8%, over the 30% line without distributed RES.

main_stats.notes: Fribbels options: Body CRIT DMG, Feet SPD, Sphere HP%/DEF%, Rope Energy Regeneration Rate. One real choice, the Sphere: HP% (first-listed). GUESS only in that DEF% is the other option; his kit scales on CRIT DMG (his Ultimate gives the target 33.6% of his CRIT DMG plus 12.8%, kit text), not on either.

distributed.notes: Fribbels substat list: CRIT DMG, SPD, RES, HP%, DEF%; buffStat CRIT DMG. CRIT DMG is filled to its cap of 10 (CRIT DMG body). SPD: 1 roll: 96 base + 5.76 (Sacerdos 2-piece, 6% of base) + 25.032 + 4.6 = 131.39, 1 roll = 133.69. GUESS: HP% 6 and DEF% 7 for the 13 left, because the preset lists HP% and DEF% and survival is modelled; no RES, since the fixed rolls already clear Broken Keel's 30% and the generic enemy applies no debuffs to allies, so RES has no other use here. SPD arithmetic ignores light cone and team SPD buffs. The cycle-1 two-turn threshold is 133.34 (20000/150); src/engine/breakpoints.test.ts pins 134 as 2 turns and 133 as 1.
